oracleRisk.summary: Vault share NAV uses internal asset/share accounting; underlying active Morpho borrower markets require collateral pricing. Exact market/oracle identities and LLTVs are inventoried, including nonzero dust; underlying feed administrators, update/staleness safeguards and complete fallback topology remain unverified. API type names alone do not establish oracle quality. Historical zero-supply positions are excluded from this current-exposure review.

branchApplicability.rationale: ERC-4626 accounting is not a borrower-oracle exemption. The current adapter exposes USDC loans secured by oracle-valued collateral, with separate liquidation branches.

branches.label: PT-reUSD-10DEC2026 / USDC
branches.summary: Morpho API identifies PT-reUSD-10DEC2026 collateral 0xecfafdc7741323a945a163ed068b5a3c43483957, market 0x1e9d614631a7df0ec07fb05b2c8cb2491575fd1a63a33bf187a6afb295a4fc64, oracle 0x217d6ddcdb95112c51657f6270e8c079cfdb51f0, type ChainlinkOracleV2. Current nonzero supply exposure is established; upstream feed/admin/staleness and per-oracle fallback controls remain unverified. Independently read Morpho 0xbbbbbbbbbb9cc5e90e3b3af64bdaf62c37eeffcb idToMarketParams(bytes32) at block 26110242 confirmed the exact oracle and LLTV; price() returned raw 979076456906618675000000000000000000. A returned price proves callability of pricing at this block, not feed freshness, liquidator execution or safe topology. Current Morpho oracleByAddress publishes baseFeedOne=0x77ee147391eac11c92817e771860ff4aad265d89. This improves the exact feed inventory; heartbeat/staleness enforcement, conversion-leg controls and complete privileged/manual update powers have not been established.

feeds.provider: Morpho market oracle (ChainlinkOracleV2 API classification; upstream topology unverified)

branches.fallbackBehavior: Morpho core invokes the configured market oracle price(); no alternate core oracle is selected. Any fallback or staleness rejection inside this exact oracle remains unverified.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable market liquidation loan-to-value from Morpho API, not vault utilization or a liquidation execution guarantee.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any external liquidator may repay debt and receive collateral when oracle-valued LTV exceeds LLTV. Actual callability and stressed sale execution on this exact feed were not measured.
branches.backstop: The reviewed code/documentation establishes permissionless incentivized liquidation; no funded exact-market recovery backstop was established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Morpho losses reduce the adapter claim; VaultV2 accrual realizes reduced realAssets as proportional share-price depreciation. No exact-market funded shutdown recovery or legal priority is established.
